body:
This M4 milestone PR adds the shared write → reread → fresh structured judgment → bounded repair path for tracker artifacts. The writing step retains its lease and content-gate responsibilities; the verifier reads the actual native artifact and returns typed findings and completed results. The production judge checks a detached repository at the exact commit before and after its independent session.

This first extraction depends on M1 [PR119](https://github.com/YalDan/kodezart/pull/119), currently `a4575cd`. Its 27-file diff preserves six whole donor files and seven independently compared source symbols; the maintained tree is identical to the frozen extraction. Independent root verification passes 842 tests in 74.86s. Author verification passed the full repository gate (3,518 tests, 16 skips; strict typing over 185 files, Ruff/format), followed by 46 passing checks after strengthening one test oracle. Fresh full maintained-head CI passed: 3,518 tests, 16 skips in 61.62s, strict185/Ruff/format368 and the literal guard. [Exact gate](https://github.com/YalDan/kodezart/actions/runs/34715355062/job/103611497895).

The artifact reader currently supports issue descriptions, addressed comments and container descriptions. Native label/criterion readback follows its shared M1 read prerequisites; graph/split readback belongs to M2. The modern typed tool boundary, configured verification-bound adoption, remaining lifecycle/semantic primitives and actual lane consumers are still being extracted. This draft does not claim complete M4, event/state authority, backend fencing or release readiness.
